graph.name: Recall an offscreen plan
graph.description:
Use a selected actor's saved plans and episodes to suggest a possible return to the visible scene.

Lesson: Recall can connect saved actor episodes to a present scene without promoting an offscreen possibility to fact. A separate Post companion internalizes only settled evidence and commits at the root.

Limitations: Actor-scoped recollection can motivate a beat; no global world simulation, scheduled timers, or arbitrary multi-actor storage exists.

Opening installs an unassigned copy. Bind local model roles and provide the documented evidence before running.

Pre: at most 1 auxiliary calls. Preview before publishing or applying.

Try changing:
Change the delivery suggestion from Rin returning in person to a supplied messenger arriving; inspect whether the proposed news is still labeled unconfirmed.
Run to Internalize before a full Post Run; compare the proposal preview with the Memory Commit Host diagnostic and its separate save acknowledgment.

Documentation specimen (does not seed chat or actor memory):

Remembered plan: Rin left to ask the ferry keeper about the missing boat.

Possible return: If supported by settled evidence, Rin can return with news. Treat an unconfirmed outcome as a possibility, not a fact.

Pre sources and interpretation: Keep both Memory readers in the root. Wire scene→Reflect context, state→Reflect/Express state, episodes→Reflect/Express episodes, Reflect→Express assessment, scene→Express context, then Express→Guidance.

Post companion: evidence → proposal → settlement: Wire Post State+Events→Internalize→Commit in a separate Post root workflow. Only a successful full root Run can settle; Run to here, preview, failed runs and imported fixture prose do not seed memory.

Local setup: Analysis bindings remain unresolved. This actor-scoped example needs real supported saved records for its memory demo; it is neither a global agenda store nor an automatic world scheduler.

Waiting at the ferry (pre-scene)
Purpose: Read six exchanges and Rin's character fields to place the remembered agenda in the current visible scene.
Fixture: Character: Rin wants to find the missing boat. Chat: Rin left to ask the ferry keeper about it. Rowan waits on the landing. No return or answer has yet been established.
Inspect: Check the latest scene does not already establish Rin's return. Scene evidence and saved history are distinct inputs.

Rin's current agenda (pre-state)
Purpose: Read scoped actor-state Data for the active host actor, including supported goals and unresolved conditions.
Fixture: Demo prerequisite: select Rin as the active actor in a disposable chat with supported stored goal/history. Empty scoped state is valid but cannot supply a remembered agenda. Import never seeds memory.
Inspect: Inspect actor/chat scope, store version, goals and evidence references. Wire this same snapshot to Reflect state and Express state; this source must stay in the root.

Saved ferry inquiry (pre-episodes)
Purpose: Read Episodes Data so Recall can cite the saved departure/inquiry episode instead of creating a new history.
Fixture: Demo prerequisite: a host-created saved episode says Rin departed to ask the ferry keeper about the missing boat. It records a plan/departure, not a successful answer. Plain JSON cannot substitute for this scoped record.
Inspect: Check episode IDs and their actual text; do not presume a result. Wire Episodes to both Reflect and Express so their evidence and versions match.

Recall the unfinished inquiry (pre-reflect)
Purpose: Appraise current Context plus state and episodes into scoped Reflection Data with attention hints.
Inspect: Inspect recalledEpisodeIds, brief and attentionHints. A plausible return is a possibility; a saved plan is not evidence that its objective succeeded.

Visible consequence hints (pre-express)
Purpose: Render Reflection attentionHints as Guidance with zero model calls; supported records can validate the same assessment evidence.
Inspect: Expect the reflection's attentionHints joined as text. Instructions and Output tokens do not reshape deterministic Attention output; author the hints in Reflect.

Offscreen agenda direction (pre-guidance)
Purpose: Deliver the possible visible consequence as bounded writing direction for the next normal generation.
Inspect: Read the Host result for evidence labels and an open player response. This graph proposes a beat; it schedules no timer and simulates no offscreen world.

pre-reflect.title: Reflect · recall
pre-reflect.instructions: Connect Rin's saved ferry inquiry only to supplied present evidence. Cite only supplied episode IDs. Distinguish the observed departure, the goal of locating the boat, and possible ways news could become visible. If no settled result exists, propose Rin returning to report an unresolved inquiry or another supported delivery opportunity; do not invent the ferry keeper's answer, boat location or elapsed travel time. Put the useful direction in attentionHints and keep player Rowan's response open. Preserve observation, interpretation and possibility labels.
